summary_rationale: Garware Hi-Tech Films has executed a multi-year structural transformation from a low-margin commodity BOPET producer (7-10% OPM in FY15-FY18) into a vertically integrated specialty polymer film franchise where Value-Added Products (Sun Control Films, Paint Protection Films, and specialty shrink/industrial grades) account for 86-87% of revenue. The business operates with zero long-term debt, ₹933 Cr in cash and equivalents as of Sep 2026, 12 consecutive years of positive operating cash flow, and ROCE that expanded from 5-8% a decade ago to 18.1% in FY26, with H1 FY27 EBITDA margins surging to 28.7%. It earns COMPOUNDER_PASS on business quality, tempered by PASS_WITH_WATCH on KPIs due to 51% geographic revenue concentration in the US (tariff and macro sensitivity that stalled FY26 top-line growth at ₹2,120 Cr vs. the initial ₹2,500 Cr target), elevated FY26 inventory days (149 days), ROE dilution from ₹813 Cr of treasury investments and FY17 asset revaluation reserves, and historical promoter-remuneration scrutiny.
